description: This file defines a class 'crudMethods' that provides methods for user authentication status check and adding data to a Firestore collection within a Food delivery app project.

classes.name: crudMethods
classes.description: A class providing CRUD operations related to restaurant data and user authentication status.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if a user is currently logged in using Firebase Authentication.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds restaurant data to the Firestore 'RestaurantData' collection if the user is logged in.
